question.text: The total number of negative charge in the tetrapeptide, Gly-Glu-Asp-Tyr, at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pH</mi><mn>12</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn></math> will be_______ (Integer answer)

solution.text: All acidic groups loose a proton to form negative charge at pH = 12.5.
